targets.rawSql: WITH live_hours AS (SELECT DISTINCT symbol, date_trunc('hour', candle_start) AS candle_hour FROM candles_1m WHERE symbol = '$symbol'), selected_candles AS (SELECT symbol, candle_start, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price FROM candles_1m WHERE symbol = '$symbol' UNION ALL SELECT symbol, candle_start, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price FROM candles_1h_backfill WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM live_hours WHERE live_hours.symbol = candles_1h_backfill.symbol AND live_hours.candle_hour = date_trunc('hour', candles_1h_backfill.candle_start))) SELECT candle_start AS time, open_price AS open, high_price AS high, low_price AS low, close_price AS close FROM selected_candles WHERE candle_start >= to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) AND candle_start <= to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo()) ORDER BY candle_start ASC
SELECT symbol, open_24h, high_24h, low_24h, close_24h, price_change, price_change_pct, total_volume, avg_volume_per_min, avg_price, updated_at FROM pair_analysis_24h ORDER BY price_change_pct DESC

WITH live_hours AS (SELECT DISTINCT symbol, date_trunc('hour', candle_start) AS candle_hour FROM candles_1m WHERE symbol = '$symbol'), selected_candles AS (SELECT symbol, candle_start, volume FROM candles_1m WHERE symbol = '$symbol' UNION ALL SELECT symbol, candle_start, volume FROM candles_1h_backfill WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM live_hours WHERE live_hours.symbol = candles_1h_backfill.symbol AND live_hours.candle_hour = date_trunc('hour', candles_1h_backfill.candle_start))) SELECT candle_start AS time, volume AS value FROM selected_candles WHERE candle_start >= to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) AND candle_start <= to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo()) ORDER BY candle_start ASC
